findings.description: No explicit minimum insert6s/withdraw4s check; archive/event durations are compared to each other and continuous rates, but the source minimum duration should independently be asserted.

Absent gravity config with a gravity candidate artifact is called passed/not_configured. It does not claim physical_success or independent_task_success, but unexpected execution evidence should prevent the legacy off result.

actual_result.curve_evidence_scope: Hash-reviewed same-object source dataflow plus saved curve/event/actual tracking. There is no independent per-step command log.
limits: The original cap validity test is not a general body embedding/self-intersection certificate; all-node count is not whole-tetrahedron or volume containment.
The 50% interim criterion never replaces original final all-node, COM, released-finger and retention checks.
401 reference/FK checks are sampled; continuous reference rates concern commands, not every native dynamic velocity.
Failed or incomplete execution never becomes successful because a planning candidate exists.
